description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources used in the AttrEval-Simulation, as referenced in the paper “Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models.” It is divided into five distinct segments, each representing a different dataset: ENTITYQUEST (blue, 26.0%), HOTPOTQA (red, 24.2%), POPQA (yellow, 21.6%), TRIVIAQA (orange, 22.7%), and TREC (green, 1.9%), with an additional small gray segment labeled 3.6% that is not explicitly named in the legend. The largest portion is ENTITYQUEST at 26.0%, followed closely by HOTPOTQA and TRIVIAQA, while TREC constitutes the smallest share. The chart uses color-coded slices with percentage labels and corresponding dataset names connected via lines, and the segments are arranged in descending order of size clockwise from the top. The unlabeled 3.6% slice may represent a miscellaneous or residual category not otherwise specified.
